text:
rachel: Need a short alignment on the private-onramp roadmap for tenant prewarm + reserved capacity. Customer wants an MVP in ~6 weeks. We need owners for runtime, infra, security, and product acceptance.
devon: Runtime can do a lightweight prewarm (KV snapshot + primed weights). Proto estimate 8 business days. Need perf targets and example config.
mateo: Infra can carve soft slots but region-us-east is tight; we can offer 5 soft-reserved slots now, + node add for more (~3w). Will need routing fallback to hosted.
priya: Security: KMS required for pilot. HSM optional. Need audit schema + rotation notes. ETA to scope: 4 business days.
rachel: Minimal acceptance I propose: 1) warm p95 < 250ms for 64-token prompts, 2) fallback to hosted <=4% under normal load, 3) KMS decrypt at boot + 30d audit retention, 4) billing tags emitted. Agree?
devon: OK on perf target for proto. I'll aim for p95 < 200ms in staging. Will attach a simple harness. Config draft tonight.
mateo: Fallback policy idea: router prefers private, fallback when reserved_util > 80% sustained 12s. Emit metric reserved_pressure. Product decide allowed fallback %.
priya: Also require per-key unwrap logs with tenant id, tstamp, request_id. I'll post minimal schema.
rachel: Product asks fallback <=3% for pilot. Rollback if fallback p99 > 1s or errors > 0.5%. Owners: runtime=devon (ETA 2w proto), infra=mateo (carve 5 slots by Apr 8), security=priya (ETA Apr 9), product=rachel (acceptance tests by Apr 7).
devon: I'll post config example: ```yaml
reserved_slots:
  tenant: acme
  count: 5
  prewarm_ttl: 10m
  fallback:
    threshold_pct: 80
    sustain_secs: 12
    route: hosted_pool
```
mateo: I'll add capacity dashboard and an alert for reserved_pressure > 90%. schedulers-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Private onramp quick sync" Fri 09:30 PT. Invites sent to @rachel @devon @mateo @priya.
rachel: Thanks team. I'll update the roadmap ticket with owners, dates, and acceptance. Ping here if anything shifts. :white_check_mark:
